text: Fire on the 3rd floor, 11980 San Vicente Blvd, Los Angeles. Smoke showing from windows.

out.briefing:
PRIMESIGHT | WORKING STRUCTURE FIRE | FLOOR 3
Brentwood Medical Plaza - 11980 San Vicente Blvd, Los Angeles, CA
ABOVE FIRE: ~281 people on floors 4-9. Fl 5 oral surgery center: possible sedated patients and O2/N2O cylinders. Fl 5 dental lab: possible solvents and torch gas (from name only)
ON FLOOR: no tenant on record (vacant, or not in data)
WATER/WIND: 22 hydrants within 300 m. Building data: 21 m NE, 66 m W. Live check: 16 m E, 71 m W. Wind from ENE 6 mph (gusts 9), smoke drifts WSW, 59F
BELOW: fl 1 pharmacy (possible O2 and aerosols) and orthopedic/spine clinic (possible limited-mobility patients) (from name only)
INSIDE: no scan of 3; nearest is floor 1 (same core, layout may differ) | 41 scan points
BUILDING: 9 stories | built 1975 | masonry frame | sprinklers: unknown | 4 passenger elevators + freight
ROOF: membrane, 9 AC units, 6 vents | OPEN LOT for staging ~119 m NE (aerial search, verify)
NEXT TO: Brentwood Court 35 m SW, 3 stories, sprinklered, close to WSW smoke drift | Montclair 76 m S, 5 stories, sprinklers unknown
NOT KNOWN: sprinkler type, stair locations, standpipe locations, property manager contact
SCAN: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=1uXpcwty9Sr

tenant_flags.tenant: West Coast Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery Center
tenant_flags.risk: Sedated or anesthetized surgical patients; probable oxygen and nitrous oxide cylinders
tenant_flags.why: An oral surgery center usually works under IV sedation or general anesthesia. Patients may not be able to leave on their own, and compressed medical gases are likely stored on site. Floor 5 is above the fire floor, in the path of smoke.

tenant_flags.risk: Likely lab hazmat: flammable resins and solvents, acids, and gas torches or cylinders
tenant_flags.why: Dental labs commonly use acrylic monomers, investment and pickling acids, and propane or oxy-fuel torches for casting. Floor 5 is above the fire floor.

tenant_flags.risk: Stored pharmaceuticals, possible oxygen cylinders, and flammable or aerosol products
tenant_flags.why: Retail pharmacies stock flammable or aerosol products, may supply medical oxygen, and hold controlled substances that need securing. Floor 1 is on the access and egress route.

tenant_flags.risk: Patients with limited mobility; possible imaging equipment or procedure sedation
tenant_flags.why: Orthopedic and spine patients often use crutches, wheelchairs or braces and may need help evacuating. The clinic may also do imaging or minor procedures.
